group_trips.title: Kuala Lumpur, Genting and Penang Group Trip
group_trips.summary: An escorted six-day Malaysia trip taking in Kuala Lumpur, Batu Caves, Genting Highlands and the heritage streets of George Town in Penang.
group_trips.overview:
This escorted trip shows you the best of peninsular Malaysia in six days. You start in Kuala Lumpur with the Petronas Twin Towers, Merdeka Square and Batu Caves, then ride a cable car up to the cool hills of Genting Highlands.

From there the group travels by road to Penang, an island known for its colonial buildings, street art, temples and food. A trip captain stays with the group throughout, and Indian meal options are available on request.
highlights: Kuala Lumpur city tour with a photo stop at the Petronas Twin Towers
Merdeka Square and the National Monument
Batu Caves and its colourful limestone temple stairway
Cable car ride to Genting Highlands
Scenic drive from Kuala Lumpur to Penang
George Town heritage walk and street art
Kek Lok Si Temple and Penang Hill by funicular railway
Trip captain with the group throughout

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kuala Lumpur | Evening at leisure
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Kuala Lumpur International Airport, where you are met and transferred to the hotel.
Check in and meet your trip captain for a short briefing on the days ahead.
The evening is free to rest or walk around the city.
Overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur City Tour | Batu Caves
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, set out on a guided tour of Kuala Lumpur with a photo stop at the Petronas Twin Towers.
See Merdeka Square and the National Monument.
Continue to Batu Caves to climb the steps to the temple cave.
Return to the hotel with free time in the evening.
Overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Genting Highlands by Cable Car
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, drive to the base of the cable car and ride up to Genting Highlands.
Enjoy the cool mountain air and views over the forested hills.
Spend the day exploring the resort area at your own pace.
Ride the cable car back down and return to Kuala Lumpur.
Overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Drive to Penang | Gurney Drive Evening
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out and travel by coach to Penang, a drive of around four to five hours with rest stops.
Check in to the hotel on arrival and rest.
In the evening, walk along the Gurney Drive seafront, known for its local food stalls.
Overnight stay in Penang.

itinerary.title: George Town Heritage | Kek Lok Si Temple | Penang Hill
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, explore George Town on a guided walk past colonial buildings, clan houses and street art.
Visit Kek Lok Si Temple, one of the largest Buddhist temples in Malaysia.
Ride the funicular railway up Penang Hill for views over the island.
Some free time is kept for shopping and snacks.
Overnight stay in Penang.

itinerary.title: Departure from Penang
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel.
Transfer to Penang International Airport for your onward flight.
Depart with memories of Malaysia.

group_trips.title: Langkawi Island Hopping and Beaches Group Trip
group_trips.summary: An escorted five-day island break in Langkawi with beach time, the Sky Bridge, island hopping to the Lake of the Pregnant Maiden and a mangrove tour.
group_trips.overview:
Langkawi is an island group off Malaysia's north-west coast, known for white-sand beaches, rainforest-covered hills and limestone islets. This relaxed five-day trip balances beach time with a mix of excursions, including the Sky Bridge on Mount Mat Cincang, an island hopping trip and a mangrove tour.

The pace is easy, with free time every day. A trip captain accompanies the group, and Indian meal options are available on request.

SkyCab cable car and Langkawi Sky Bridge on Mount Mat Cincang
Eagle Square and Langkawi island tour
Island hopping to Pulau Dayang Bunting and the Lake of the Pregnant Maiden
Beras Basah Island beach stop
Mangrove tour with Gua Kelawar (Bat Cave) and limestone formations
Trip captain with the group throughout

honeymoon_trips.title: Malaysia Honeymoon: Langkawi Beaches and Kuala Lumpur Lights
honeymoon_trips.summary: A private six-night honeymoon with four unhurried nights on Langkawi and two in Kuala Lumpur, with a candlelight dinner, a sunset cruise, a couples spa session and a cable car ride to the Sky Bridge.
honeymoon_trips.overview:
Begin your married life on Langkawi, an island of quiet beaches, rainforest and limestone hills. Four nights here are paced for rest: a flower welcome on arrival, a private ride up the cable car to the Sky Bridge, a boat day to the Lake of the Pregnant Maiden, a couples spa session and a sunset cruise, with plenty of free time on the sand between.

You then fly to Kuala Lumpur for two nights of city lights. Watch the Petronas Twin Towers glow after dark, step inside Batu Caves and ride the cable car up to Genting Highlands, where the air is cool and the clouds drift past below you.

Every transfer and sightseeing day is by private car, with late starts and no rushed mornings. The Langkawi to Kuala Lumpur flight is not included, so you can pick the timing that suits you.
highlights: Flower welcome and bed decoration on arrival, subject to availability
Cable car ride and the curved Sky Bridge high above Langkawi's rainforest
Candlelight dinner for two on the island
Island hopping to the Lake of the Pregnant Maiden on Pulau Dayang Bunting
Couples spa session and a sunset cruise on a free-paced day
Petronas Twin Towers and the Kuala Lumpur skyline lit up at night
Private day trip to Batu Caves and the cable car up to Genting Highlands

itinerary.title: Arrival in Langkawi | Sunset at Pantai Cenang
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Langkawi airport and meet your private driver for the transfer to your resort.
Check in to a sea-view or garden-view room, with a flower welcome or bed decoration subject to availability.
Rest and settle in, then stroll along Pantai Cenang as the sun goes down.
Dinner is at leisure, with plenty of beachfront places to choose from.
Overnight stay in Langkawi.

itinerary.title: Cable Car and Sky Bridge | Candlelight Dinner
itinerary.description:
After a relaxed breakfast, your private car takes you to the Oriental Village for the cable car.
Ride up Gunung Mat Cincang and walk the curved Sky Bridge for wide views over the rainforest and the Andaman Sea.
Return to the resort for a lazy afternoon by the pool or on the beach.
This evening, enjoy a candlelight dinner for two, subject to availability.
Overnight stay in Langkawi.

itinerary.title: Island Hopping | Lake of the Pregnant Maiden
itinerary.description:
Start late and head to the jetty for a half-day island hopping trip.
Visit Pulau Dayang Bunting and its freshwater Lake of the Pregnant Maiden, where you can swim or take a quiet walk.
Stop at Beras Basah Island for a beach break and clear water.
Return to the hotel by afternoon, with the evening free for a sunset walk.
Overnight stay in Langkawi.

itinerary.title: Spa Day at Leisure | Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description:
Today has no fixed sightseeing, so sleep in and enjoy breakfast at your own pace.
Book into a couples spa session at the resort, subject to availability.
Spend the afternoon on the beach, by the pool or browsing Langkawi's duty-free shops.
In the evening, board a sunset cruise and watch the sky turn gold over the water.
Overnight stay in Langkawi.

itinerary.title: Fly to Kuala Lumpur | Petronas Towers by Night
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, your private driver takes you to Langkawi airport for your flight to Kuala Lumpur (flight not included).
On arrival, a private transfer takes you to your city hotel.
Rest in the afternoon, then go out for a short city tour as evening falls.
See the Petronas Twin Towers lit up and walk through KLCC Park for photographs.
Overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Batu Caves and Genting Highlands
itinerary.description:
Leave after a relaxed breakfast with your private car and driver.
Stop at Batu Caves to see the golden statue and climb the rainbow-coloured steps to the cave temple.
Continue up to Genting Highlands and take the cable car through the clouds.
Walk in the cool mountain air and explore the hill resort at your own pace.
Return to Kuala Lumpur in the evening.
Overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a last breakfast at the hotel and check out around 12 noon.
Your private driver takes you to Kuala Lumpur airport for your onward flight home.
You leave with your honeymoon memories.
